coverage: Explicit transient classes, bounded backoff and retained failed attempts; exact frozen contracts and input leases; terminal dependency blocking and independent continuation.

Real publication crash boundaries preserve committed outputs and undelivered notifications; old sessions cannot publish. Recovery never signals a saved PID and private capabilities authorize only worker self-group cleanup.

Public implicit planning/new registration, exact saved drafts, no-wait preflight, history/log inspection, historical source and input replay, Ctrl-C, authenticated persistent ownership, failed/WARN check visibility and restart queues.
corrected_during_verification: A deep execution report exposed artificial recursion depth in schema expansion. Runtime/test validators now bound actual JSON metadata depth; five cross-language conformance cases cover execution success/failure/cancellation and closed result fields.
The new recursive JSON type exposed TypeScript Record alias recursion restrictions. The schema generator now emits readonly index signatures; generated types and all 309 web tests pass.
The public cache fixture retained a previous clock-using producer; restored the original fixture before the public journeys.
Updated the explicit shared fixture count from 250 to 255 and resolved compiler/lint issues before passing checks.
Cancellation releases active capability slots only after cleanup; completed failed attempts are not rewritten by cancellation during retry wait.
Worker disconnect cleanup terminates its own group, and recovery tolerates a concurrent completed disconnect cleanup during authentication.

One full native run stopped at the existing draft expiry/backwards-clock guard. No production guard was relaxed; a fresh full qualification run was used for final verification. The initial error alone does not distinguish expiry from a backwards clock adjustment.

The new human WARN/progress test exposed an invocation-wide stderr lock deadlock. The executable now locks individual writes, allowing the progress thread to drain and join; the native scenario guards this regression.
limits: Local macOS arm64 evidence only; Linux qualification awaits owner-monitored push workflows.

Persistent CLI coordinator runs one build at a time, with concurrent jobs. HTTP/UI, scheduling and daemon installation remain later work; standalone plan/catalogue mutations require stopping this owner.
Polars execution only; declared secret delivery is refused. Foreign replay and individual check-certificate reuse remain separate work.
Public configured-memory admission reserves the full budget per job; no default memory cap or enforced RSS guarantee.
No automatic retry of coordinator interruption. Trusted Python may escape its process group; isolation is not hostile-code containment.

Runtime schema 8, worker protocol 1.0, AST 1 and specification 1.1.2 unchanged. Ctrl-C support adds locked signal-hook-registry 1.4.8 (MIT OR Apache-2.0), covered by native qualification and advisory inventory.
